text: Browser automation can wait for an authored page condition before continuing; readiness need not be inferred from a fixed delay.
Programmatic video implementations convert authored time into frame positions and await the selected render state.
Frame extraction and subtitle ranges can be derived from an authored timeline.
Caption timing belongs to the associated speech timeline.
Inspected renderer implementations await frame seeking and rendering readiness before producing image output.
review_note: Remotion seek-to-frame awaits readiness around frame selection and fonts; Motion Canvas renderFrame awaits seek then stage.render before handleFrame. Describes these observed mechanisms, not a claim of identical APIs.

text: Inspected video tools resolve requested still images from authored timeline positions.
review_note: Motion Canvas converts requested seconds to frame and seeks; explainroo resolves requested times against scene starts/ends before still exports.

text: Inspected media implementations carry explicit timeline timestamps into caption generation or frame encoding.
review_note: Explainroo adds scene start to word timing and trims cues to cut range; Playwright records explicit timestamps; fframes passes frame index as PTS. Abstract shared pattern only.

text: Inspected media test suites decode encoded output to check image or video properties.
review_note: fframes renders and decodes center pixel; Playwright VideoPlayer decodes saved video for dimensions/duration/pixels. Tests were inspected, not executed.
